items.text: I am so sick of this constant nonsense ruining my entire day completely
Why does nobody care about the basic rules anymore is beyond me
This is absolutely unacceptable and I have had enough of this mess
I cannot believe they actually pulled this stunt right in front of us
Stop wasting my time with these pathetic excuses and broken promises now
I am furious about how they completely ignored all my hard work today
This is the absolute worst customer service I have ever witnessed in life
Why are they still pretending everything is fine when it is clearly broken
I am done dealing with this incompetence and terrible attitude from management
Nothing ever changes and I am so tired of this endless frustration now
Another day another fine for something ridiculous that nobody actually understands.
They promised change but everything stays exactly the same as before.
Why is customer service never actually able to help anyone ever?
My package arrived damaged again and now I have to fight.
Nobody seems to care about the rules anymore except when it suits them.
Waiting on hold for an hour just to get hung up on.

Walking in the park and feeling grateful for every single breath I take.

Listening to my favorite song on repeat and dancing around the living room.
